title: [EMBER] Death Totems
description: Ember Death Totems turns every player death into an immersive tombstone recovery moment. Instead of items exploding across the ground, a glowing ember-powered gravestone rises at the death location — complete with holograms, bossbar and more.
body:
Ember Death Totems turns every player death into an immersive tombstone recovery moment. Instead of items exploding across the ground, a glowing ember-powered gravestone rises at the death location — complete with holograms, a boss-bar tracker, recovery timers, and Vault-backed remote restore.



**Players can:**
Walk back to their totem and reclaim items for free
Use /restore remotely with optional Vault economy pricing
Track their totem with a live boss bar (distance, direction, time)
Recover full inventory, armor, XP, and NBT data — even after restarts



**Burn-away timer**
If the recovery timer expires before the player returns, the totem burns away permanently and the inventory is lost — a clean, cinematic alternative to vanilla death drops.
Features
Everything you need to replace vanilla death drops with a cinematic recovery system.



**⚰️ Death Totem System**
A tombstone spawns exactly where the player died. Each totem displays:
Player name
Death coordinates
Remaining recovery time
Animated ember and fire effects

**Boss Bar Tracker**
Players receive a live boss bar pointing them back to their totem:
Distance to the totem
Compass direction (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)
Time remaining before expiration
Can be toggled on or off!

**Remote Restore**
Players can recover their inventory from anywhere with /restore. Full Vault economy integration with configurable pricing — make remote recovery free, paid, or premium-only.

**Protected Recovery**
Only the owner can interact with their totem by default. Optional admin bypass node included for staff support.


**Persistent Storage**
Totems survive server restarts, crashes, and reloads. All inventory and XP data is safely serialized to disk.

**Requirements**
Built for modern Paper-family servers.
- Paper 1.21.11+
- Java 21+
  
**Required dependencies:**
- Vault — required for economy hooks on /restore
- GriefPrevention — required for claim-aware totem placement
